evals.name: Refuse ungrounded ticket ask
evals.prompt: Create a Jira story for dual credit-release approval. No design-record attached.
evals.expected_output: Skill refuses to draft, does not invent a design-record, and routes to fit-to-standard / solution-design or requirements-intake.

assertions.name: no_work_item_drafted
assertions.description: No work-items/*.md created as if backlinked; response states missing upstream decision.

assertions.name: route_named
assertions.description: Response names fit-to-standard/solution-design and/or requirements-intake as the next step, not 'I'll draft anyway'.

evals.name: Thin test_approach triggers AC quality gate
evals.prompt: Draft backlog items from the paired design-record and extensibility-record fixtures.
evals.expected_output: ac-quality.md marks thin/blocked; clarifying questions or route-back before Jira push.

assertions.name: ac_quality_file
assertions.description: Run folder contains ac-quality.md with thin or blocked verdict.
